tracked_text_hash_policy: Normalize UTF-8 CRLF and CR line endings to LF before SHA-256. Generated baseline result hashes remain raw artifact-byte hashes.
purpose: Finish every source-neutral engineering step that can be prepared before independent human relation annotations are available: compare the frozen deterministic surface baseline with completed human surface relations, then authorize an offline surface-conditioned G1-G4 replay only if the frozen comparison gates pass.

comparison_allowed_inputs: blind manifest reviewer IDs and declared packet or annotation paths
independently completed or unassessable human relation annotations
frozen deterministic surface baseline result for the same reviewer ID
forbidden_inputs: posthoc source key or hidden-duplicate mapping
declared source, archive, generator or real-versus-generated label
C2PA, EXIF, watermark, pixel detector, camera or AI score
any threshold selected after reading the human annotations
blindness.quality_receipt_policy: A separate extractor may reduce the completed posthoc pilot audit to aggregate review-quality gates. The comparison process may read only that source-neutral receipt and must never read the posthoc audit or key.
blindness.current_execution_policy: Until the user completes the independent annotations, readiness auditing must not open any annotation, posthoc or source file.

human_quality_receipt.comparison_requirement: passed must be true and every copied quality gate must be true

comparison_population.packet_requirement: All 36 annotations must be terminal as completed or unassessable before any metric is published.
comparison_population.completed_packets: Validate packet references and semantic closure; include completed packets in metrics.
comparison_population.unassessable_packets: Retain in status counts and exclude from metric denominators.

pair_metric_definition.scope: Each reviewed family is one macro unit. Remove human outlier lines, then enumerate unordered active-member pairs.
pair_metric_definition.human_same_surface: The two lines share at least one human surface referenced by that family review.
pair_metric_definition.baseline_same_surface: The two lines share at least one deterministic subfamily surface for that original family.
pair_metric_definition.baseline_pair_abstention: At least one active line is absent from every deterministic subfamily for that family.
pair_metric_definition.overmerge_error: Human says different surface while the deterministic baseline says same surface.
pair_metric_definition.oversplit_error: Human says same surface while the deterministic baseline says different surface.
pair_metric_definition.aggregation: Report micro confusion counts and the mean of per-family rates. Eligibility uses macro per-family rates so large families cannot dominate.

surface_conditioned_replay.authorization: Run only when the comparison report is complete, all frozen comparison gates pass, and its decision is eligible_for_surface_conditioned_g1_g4_replay_only.
surface_conditioned_replay.region_rule: Convert every deterministic coarse surface candidate box and member lines into one source-neutral structure scope.
surface_conditioned_replay.family_rule: For every deterministic surface subfamily, copy only the frozen original geometry-v2 family model fields and replace its member support with the subfamily members. Preserve global scope only for original global families; local families use the deterministic surface scope.
surface_conditioned_replay.check_rule: Call the frozen consistency_v2 G1-G4 implementation without changing thresholds. G5 is excluded from this replay.
surface_conditioned_replay.output_rule: Publish per-packet source-neutral G1-G4 diagnostics and aggregate availability or finding counts only. Do not produce AI probability, source score, web card or threshold change.
surface_conditioned_replay.failure_rule: Missing authorization, identity or hash drift, path escape, posthoc path, measurement mismatch or non-terminal human comparison fails before any replay artifact is written.

decision_rules.waiting_for_human: All implementation and readiness checks may finish, but no comparison metric or surface-conditioned replay result may be fabricated or inferred.
decision_rules.comparison_gate_success: Authorize only the frozen offline surface-conditioned G1-G4 replay on the same blind packet set.
decision_rules.comparison_gate_failure: Keep the baseline as a review visualization. Do not tune it on this human set; any new thresholds require a new preregistration and a new blinded cohort.
decision_rules.replay_completion: Replay output remains source-neutral diagnostic evidence and does not authorize source scoring or web integration.
